title: AttackOnTitan
note: 译文由大模型按官方简体中文术语机器翻译自官方英文站卡牌原文，未经人工校对，仅供参考；以卡面原文为准。

paragraphs.original: 《When Played》 Look at the top three cards of your deck. Reveal up to one <Levi> card among them and add it to your hand. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you added a card to your hand, place one card from your hand into your sideline.
paragraphs.translation: 【登场时】确认我方卡组顶部的3张牌。公开其中最多1张〈利威尔〉卡并将其加入我方手牌。将剩余的牌以任意顺序置于我方卡组最下方。若将牌加入手牌，则将我方手牌中的1张牌退场。

paragraphs.original: 《Activate: Main》 《Pay 1 AP》 《Once Per Turn》 This character gains 《Blue》 energy generation until the end of the turn. At the start of the attack phase this turn, choose up to one of your AP cards and switch it to active.
paragraphs.translation: 【启动主要】[支付1AP][每回合1次] 本回合中，该角色获得[蓝]能量生成。本回合攻击阶段开始时，选择我方至多1张AP卡，将其转为活跃状态。

paragraphs.original: 《When Played》 You may choose one active [Inheritor of the Titan] or [Pure Titan] affinity card on your field or your opponent's field and switch it to resting. If you do, the player whose character was switched to resting with this ability draws a card.
paragraphs.translation: 【登场时】我方场上或对手场上选择1张处于活跃状态的〈进击的巨人〉或〈无垢巨人〉特征卡，将其转为休息状态。若如此做，其角色因该能力转为休息状态的玩家抽1张卡。

paragraphs.original: 《During Your Turn》 If you have paid an AP cost during the attack phase this turn, this character gains 2000 BP.
paragraphs.translation: 【我方的回合中】如果我方在本回合的攻击阶段支付过AP费用，该角色BP+2000。

paragraphs.original: 《Activate: Main》 《Switch to Resting》 《Once Per Turn》 This character gains 《Blue》 energy generation until the end of the turn. At the end of the main phase, sideline this character.
paragraphs.translation: 【启动主要】[转为休息状态][每回合1次] 该角色本回合中获得[蓝]能量生成。在主要阶段结束时，将该角色退场。

paragraphs.original: 《When Played》 At the start of the attack phase this turn, choose up to one of your AP cards and switch it to active.
paragraphs.translation: 【登场时】本回合攻击阶段开始时，选择我方最多1张AP卡，将其转为活跃状态。

paragraphs.original: 《When Attacking》 You may pay 1 AP. If you do, draw a card and give this character 500 BP until the end of the turn.
paragraphs.translation: 【攻击时】我方可[支付1AP]。若如此做，抽1张卡，并使我方场上的这张角色本回合中+500 BP。

paragraphs.original: 《When Attacking》 You may pay 1 AP. If you do, draw a card and give this character 1000 BP until the end of the turn.
paragraphs.translation: 【攻击时】我方可支付1AP。若如此做，抽1张卡，且本回合中该角色BP+1000。

paragraphs.original: 《If on the Front Line》 At the start of your attack phase, if this character is active, choose up to one of your AP cards and switch it to active.
paragraphs.translation: 【在前线时】在攻击阶段开始时，若该角色处于活跃状态，选择至多1张我方AP卡，并将其转为活跃状态。

paragraphs.original: 《When Attacking》 You may pay 1 AP. If you do, choose up to one character on your field. It gains 1000 BP and "This character cannot be chosen by your opponent's trigger abilities" until the end of the turn.
paragraphs.translation: 【攻击时】我方可以[支付1AP]。若如此做，选择我方场上的至多1张角色。本回合中，该角色获得1000 BP，且“该角色不能被对手的触发能力选择”。

paragraphs.original: 《Raid》 <Levi> Switch to active. May move to the front line.
paragraphs.translation: 《突进》〈利威尔〉转为活跃状态。可移动至前线。

paragraphs.original: 《Once Per Turn》 At the end of this character's attack, you may pay 1 AP. If you do, switch this character to active.
paragraphs.translation: [每回合1次] 该角色攻击结束时，我方可以[支付1AP]。若如此做，将该角色转为活跃状态。

paragraphs.original: 《When Played》 This character gains 1000 BP, 《Double Attack》 (When this character attacks for the first time this turn, switch it to active), and "When this character attacks a third time this turn, it gains 《Snipe》 (You may target a character on your opponent's front line and attack it with this character. If you do, your opponent cannot block) until the end of the attack" until the end of the turn.
paragraphs.translation: 【登场时】该角色BP+1000，获得《双重攻击》（本回合中该角色首次攻击时，[转为活跃状态]），以及“本回合中该角色第3次攻击时，获得《瞄准攻击》（可指定对手前线上的1张角色，以该角色进行攻击。若如此做，对手不能阻挡）直至攻击结束”，本回合中。

paragraphs.original: 《During Opponent's Turn》 If <Historia Reiss> is on your field, this character gains 1000 BP.
paragraphs.translation: 【对手的回合中】若〈希斯特利亚·雷斯〉在我方场上，该角色BP+1000。

paragraphs.original: 《Raid》 <Ymir> Switch to active. May move to the front line.
paragraphs.translation: 《突进》 〈尤弥尔〉 [转为活跃状态]。可移动至前线。

paragraphs.original: 《When Attacking》 《Once Per Turn》 Draw a card, then place one card from your hand into your sideline. Then, if you have six or more event cards in your sideline, you may switch this character to active.
paragraphs.translation: 【攻击时】[每回合1次] 抽1张卡，然后将手牌中的1张卡置于退场区。然后，若我方退场区中有6张以上事件卡，我方可以将此角色转为活跃状态。

paragraphs.original: 《When Played》 Return one other character on your field with 1 or less required energy to your hand. If you cannot, return this character to your hand.
paragraphs.translation: 【登场时】将我方场上的1张所需能量为1以下的其他角色返回我方手牌。若无法如此做，将此角色返回我方手牌。

paragraphs.original: If there is a green or red card on your opponent's field, reduce this card's required energy by 《Blue×1》 while in your hand.
paragraphs.translation: 此卡在我方手牌中时，若对手场上有[绿]或[红]卡牌，则此卡所需能量减少[蓝×1]。

paragraphs.original: 《Nullify Impact》 (The character battling this character loses 《Impact》 for the duration of this battle.)
paragraphs.translation: 《冲击无效》（与这张角色战斗的角色在本次战斗中失去《冲击》。）

paragraphs.original: 《Double Block》 (When this character blocks for the first time this turn, switch it to active.)
paragraphs.translation: 《双重阻挡》（本回合中，此角色首次阻挡时，将其转为活跃状态。）

paragraphs.original: 《When Played》 Look at the top two cards of your deck. {Place them on the top of your deck in any order}. If a character with "Ymir" in its card name is on your field, {Place any number of them on the top of your deck in any order, then place any remaining cards into your sideline} instead.

paragraphs.original: If a character with "Ymir" in its card name is on your field, this character gains 500 BP.
paragraphs.translation: 若我方场上有卡名包含“尤弥尔”的角色，该角色BP+500。

paragraphs.original: 《When Played》 If you have used an event card this turn, choose up to one of your AP cards and switch it to active. You can only activate this <Historia Reiss> ability one time each turn.
paragraphs.translation: 【登场时】如果我方在本回合中使用过事件卡，选择我方最多1张AP卡，并将其激活。此〈希斯特利亚·雷斯〉能力[每回合1次]。

paragraphs.original: This character gains all abilities listed below if you have the required number of event cards in your sideline.
paragraphs.translation: 如果我方退场区有规定数量的事件卡，此角色获得以下所有能力。

paragraphs.original: ・Two or more: 《When Attacking》 Choose up to one other [104th Cadet Corps] affinity card on your field. It gains 1000 BP until the end of the turn.
paragraphs.translation: ・2张以上：【攻击时】选择我方场上的至多1张其他〈104期训练兵团〉特征卡。该卡本回合中BP+1000。

paragraphs.original: ・Four or more: 《Activate: Main》 《If on the Front Line》 《Once Per Turn》 If you have used an event card this turn, choose up to one of your AP cards and switch it to active.
paragraphs.translation: 4张以上：【启动主要】【在前线时】[每回合1次] 若我方本回合使用过事件卡，选择我方最多1张AP卡，并将其转为活跃状态。

paragraphs.original: ・Six or more: 《Impact (1)》

paragraphs.original: This character gains all abilities listed below if you have the required number of event cards in your sideline.

paragraphs.translation: 该角色造成伤害而进行触发检查时，对手无法发动《活跃触发》能力。

cards.name: Former Headquarters of the Scout Regiment

paragraphs.original: 《Activate: Main》 《Switch to Resting》 Reveal the top card of your deck. If the revealed card is a blue character card with 3 or less required energy, add it to your hand. If you do not add it to your hand, place it on the top of your deck.
paragraphs.translation: 【启动主要】[转为休息状态] 公开我方卡组最上方的1张卡。若公开的卡为所需能量为3或以下的[蓝]角色卡，将其加入我方手牌。若未将其加入我方手牌，将其置于我方卡组最上方。

paragraphs.original: Draw a card, then place one card from your hand into your sideline. Choose up to one of your AP cards and switch it to active.
paragraphs.translation: 抽1张卡，然后将手牌中的1张卡置于退场区。选择我方最多1张AP卡，将其转为活跃状态。

paragraphs.original: Choose up to two of your AP cards and switch them to active.
paragraphs.translation: 选择至多2张我方AP卡，将其激活。

paragraphs.original: Look at the top two cards of your deck. Place any number of them on the top of your deck in any order, then place any remaining cards into your sideline. Draw two cards.
paragraphs.translation: 确认我方卡组顶部的2张卡。将其中任意数量的卡以任意顺序置于我方卡组顶部，然后将剩余的卡置于我方退场区。抽2张卡。

paragraphs.original: Choose up to one character with 3500 or less BP on your opponent's front line and return it to their hand.
paragraphs.translation: 选择对手前线上的至多1张BP在3500以下的角色，将其返回对手手牌。

paragraphs.original: Choose one character with {2000} or less BP on your opponent's front line and sideline it. If <Historia Reiss> is on your field, add 1000 to the BP range of the character you may choose with this ability for each event card in your sideline.
paragraphs.translation: 选择对手前线上的1张BP{2000}以下的角色，将其退场。如果我方场上有〈希斯特利亚·雷斯〉，我方退场区中每有1张事件卡，此能力可选择的角色的BP范围便+1000。

paragraphs.original: Choose one character with {3000 or less BP} on your opponent's front line and sideline it. If <Levi> is on your field, {5000 or less BP} instead.
paragraphs.translation: 选择对手前线上的1张{BP3000以下}角色，使其退场。若〈利威尔〉在我方场上，则改为{BP5000以下}。
